response.sql: WITH site_averages AS (SELECT p."zoneref", s."entrystat", AVG(p."memusagegb") AS avg_ram_gb, AVG(p."procgpu"::numeric / NULLIF(p."proccpu", 0)) AS avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM "scanprocessing" AS p JOIN "sites" AS s ON s."zoneregistry" = p."zoneref" WHERE p."memusagegb" > 60.8 GROUP BY p."zoneref", s."entrystat") SELECT "entrystat", AVG(avg_ram_gb) AS avg_site_ram_gb, AVG(avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) AS avg_site_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM site_averages GROUP BY "entrystat"

assumptions.assumption: Runs with zero CPU usage have an undefined GPU-to-CPU ratio and are excluded from ratio averages.
